input.note: I want to understand how to have medicine delivered to my home without going out.

batch.message: One new step for what you need now.

tasks.title: Find out how pharmacy delivery works
tasks.summary: Delivery rules depend on the pharmacy and the prescription. A pharmacy can clarify whether delivery is available to your address and what the process requires.
steps: Choose a pharmacy’s official website or customer-service route; CVS’s delivery information is one place to start.
Check which prescriptions and delivery areas are eligible, and whether charges or timing differ by prescription or location.
Look for identification and handoff requirements, and note what would still need confirming for a specific future prescription.
tasks.done_when: You understand the delivery route’s main limits and what the pharmacy would need to confirm for a specific prescription.

resources.why: A reviewed US pharmacy-delivery starting point; its actual eligibility, charges and handoff rules need checking.
